comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: It's not that Gobelin Tapestry's are bad, it's just that backstock rates for fabrics in general are high in most EA ports that it's hard to find to good rate for them. It seems Hangzhou is the best EA port so far for fabrics, with Busan, Sakai, and Edo coming in a close second to trade for them. Surprisingly enough, it's not Gobelin Tapestry's (or any other fabric from the Europe), that get the best rates, but homegrown ones from EA such as Chinese Rugs, Japanese Brocade, etc. Go figure that out!
